page_title: LIV 2-1 CHE | Liverpool v Chelsea 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+6' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
90+5' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

90+3' Renato Veiga (Chelsea) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
90+2' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) for his blatant foul.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
86' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
86' The ball is cleared after Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is able to continue to play.
84' Looks like Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
83' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Chelsea.
81' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) replaces Trent Alexander-Arnold.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Curtis Jones cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' The referee has issued a yellow card to Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).

80' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
78' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Renato Veiga (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
77' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
77' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is replacing Noni Madueke.
75' The referee blows his whistle as Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) was too aggressive in his challenge. Liverpool win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
74' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) commits a rough foul. John Brooks stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Chelsea, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
73' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
72' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
71' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
71' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

70' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee John Brooks saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Chelsea, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
69' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Liverpool earn a free kick.
67' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Here comes a substitution. Cody Gakpo is given a rest as he is replaced by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
65' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
65' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Cole Palmer (Chelsea). Chelsea earn a corner.

63' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Chelsea win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
62' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) produces a nice first-time shot from a promising distance. Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off a quality save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
62' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

60' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.

60' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Liverpool.
57' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
53' Tosin Adarabioyo goes off the pitch and Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) comes on.
53' Enzo Maresca has decided to substitute Reece James and he is replaced by Renato Veiga (Chelsea).
53' Substitution. Romeo Lavia did his best and is replaced by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea).
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Great play by Mohamed Salah releases Curtis Jones (Liverpool) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 2:1.
48' 1 - 1 Referee John Brooks points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) goes wild in celebration.
48' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) scores a goal, but John Brooks makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
48' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
46' Enzo Maresca has made a change at the break. Pedro Neto (Chelsea) has come on in place of Jadon Sancho.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+8' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45+5' The penalty decision is reversed after referee John Brooks changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
45+3' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.

45+2' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and John Brooks blows for a foul. Liverpool are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner which is cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) heads on.
44' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
42' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
40' The ball has crossed the sideline. Chelsea are taking a throw-in.
39' Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Robert Sanchez.
35' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
33' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
32' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Diogo Jota is being substituted because of an injury. Arne Slot sends Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) on the pitch.
29' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Robert Sanchez no chance!
28' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
28' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into John Brooks's book.

26' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement. PENALTY to Liverpool! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
26' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
26' Arne Slot (Liverpool) gets a yellow card, off the field.
25' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
24' John Brooks blows his whistle and it's Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
23' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
23' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' Reece James (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman makes the right call and Chelsea will have a corner.
21' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
17' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a throw-in.
16' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
14' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
13' The ball is out of play. Liverpool will take a throw-in.

12' A precise low pass is received by Malo Gusto (Chelsea), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
12' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
11' Wonderful movement by Liverpool. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
10' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
9' Liverpool continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
7' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
6' Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
6' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

5' Chelsea slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' Reece James (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
2' Chelsea are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Chelsea decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
2' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Chelsea.
1' Reece James (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and John Brooks blows for a foul. Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be John Brooks.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
